title: Interpreting SSL Representations for Spoof Detection: a WavLM Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.23526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised speech models such as WavLM achieve strong spoofing detection performance, yet which layers encode the most spoof-relevant information and what acoustic properties they capture remain opaque. We present a layer-wise interpretability study of WavLM using the ASVspoof 5 database, combining three complementary analyses: (i) per-layer linear probing with attack-level evaluation across speech synthesis, voice conversion, and adversarial attacks; (ii) a canonical correlation analysis (CCA) linking layer representations to spoofing-relevant acoustic features; (iii) an exhaustive grid search over layer subsets showing that use of five layers outperforms full thirteen-layer pooling. CCA analysis reveals that, while most acoustic features peak in alignment with mid-layers and then decay, voice quality measures jitter, shimmer, and the harmonics-to-noise ratio show the opposite trend, with correlation increasing toward later layer

translated_title: 解读用于欺骗检测的自监督学习表征：一项WavLM研究
translated_abstract: 诸如WavLM之类的自监督语音模型在欺骗检测任务上取得了优异的性能，然而哪些层编码了最多的欺骗相关信息、以及这些层捕获了哪些声学特性，目前仍不清楚。我们基于ASVspoof 5数据库对WavLM开展了一项逐层可解释性研究，结合了三种互补的分析方法：（i）逐层线性探测，并针对语音合成、语音转换和对抗攻击进行攻击级别的评估；（ii）典型相关分析（CCA），将各层表征与欺骗相关的声学特征建立联系；（iii）对各层子集进行详尽的网格搜索，结果表明仅使用五个层的效果优于全部十三层的池化。CCA分析揭示，虽然大多数声学特征与中间层的对齐程度达到峰值随后衰减，但语音质量指标——基频微扰、振幅微扰和谐噪比却呈现相反的趋势，其相关性随着层数加深而不断增强。
tldr: 本研究对WavLM在语音欺骗检测中的逐层表征进行了系统的可解释性分析，发现仅选取五个关键层的组合性能优于全部十三层池化，并通过典型相关分析揭示了各声学特征与不同层之间的关联规律。
en_tdlr: This layer-wise interpretability study of WavLM for spoof detection demonstrates that a subset of five layers outperforms full thirteen-layer pooling, and uses CCA to reveal how spoof-relevant acoustic features align differently across model layers.
